pull_request.title: Tracker: integrate 703 mm strixel modules, services and TDR
pull_request.head: codex/short-strip-services-2mm-baseline
pull_request.body:
## Executive summary

Integrate the human-requested **703 mm short-strip module/services redesign** into the maintained combined DD4hep tracker, following the 2 mm readout selection in merged #109. The actual ODD TDR has been updated, compiled, visually checked and published to the explicitly authorized Overleaf main branch at `80a6c998cb9002d0d116bd8c4a414193e904bbd2`.

- Short-strip endcaps now contain **396 modules/disc, 4,752 in total**, with five redesigned rings. The sampled full-azimuth target is 703 mm; the finite active corner reaches 704.909 mm. The active radial gap to unchanged long strips falls **114.758 → 82.335 mm**.
- Default DD4hep includes the redesigned two-tile module stack, backing/core windows, direct thermal saddles, 0.17 mm local copper, two cooling loops per endcap petal and one partitioned **717–781.5 mm** shared service trunk. Power, optical and cooling counts are independent; fan/trunk payload and tray walls are counted once.
- The conservative changed-component estimate is **−114.6 kg with no cable-insulation credit** (−287.8 kg under the original insulation proxy). This is a scoped design estimate, not a complete tracker mass or directional material result.

The complete tracker has **46,682 sensitive planes / 54 signed groups**. Pixel and long-strip sensors are preserved. The historical 46,250-plane physical geometry and its evidence remain explicit controls.

![Redesigned module stack and thermal contacts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/codex/short-strip-services-2mm-baseline/docs/validation/DES-043/figures/module-redesign.png)

![Radial handoff and service capacity](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/codex/short-strip-services-2mm-baseline/docs/validation/DES-043/figures/handoff-capacity.png)

## Change

Governing design: [DES043](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/short-strip-services-2mm-baseline/docs/design/DES-043-short-strip-service-redesign.md), including the dated explicit working-baseline integration amendment. The human authorized module redesign and this integration; **DRAFT / PROTOTYPE engineering status remains**.

- [Design findings, plots and qualification boundaries](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/short-strip-services-2mm-baseline/docs/validation/DES-043/README.md)
- [Combined native / ACTS / Geant4 evidence and reproduction](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/short-strip-services-2mm-baseline/docs/validation/DES-043/integration/README.md)
- [Independent revision-specific assessment](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/short-strip-services-2mm-baseline/docs/validation/DES-043/integration/assessment.md)
- [Actual TDR source and publication receipt](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/short-strip-services-2mm-baseline/docs/publication/short-strip-services-2026-11-03/README.md)
- [Updated layout main page and separate DES043 drawing inputs](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/short-strip-services-2mm-baseline/docs/layouts/README.md)

The full native implementation is frozen at `d6c4d0ddfa9e14129a3f4c426fced7c4cee0dcc4`. A supplementary audit closes three demonstrated checker gaps: complete source/artifact/contact coverage, unexpected passive solids and native mixture fractions. General intersecting CSG receives explicit volume/mass bounds; no falsely exact complete mass is asserted.

**Qualification limits:** the complete adverse thermal screen leaves only **0.333 K** to the −20 °C sensor limit. ASIC feasibility, the finished 8 mm cable package, cold bonds/contacts, upstream leakage path, irradiation and two-phase hydraulics remain unqualified. Existing 2 mm truth/GBTS/ttbar results used the previous physical geometry. Full new-geometry directional material, curved navigation and performance comparisons remain follow-up work.

## Dashboard and validation

- [x] New scientific tracker integration task and current design/layout/TDR records identify the delivered work and remaining qualifications; no engineering sign-off inferred.
- [x] **108,852,277 observed input+output tokens across 17 closed turns**, owned once by the November 2 design and November 3 integration journals. Cached input/reasoning are subsets. The active parent turn and unknown models/client version remain explicitly excluded.
- [x] Retained all ten design PNG/PDF plots, current layout views, compact aggregate evidence and complete reproduction scripts. **No generated XML, full inventories, ROOT/NPZ/event dumps, Gen3 payloads, compiled reports, caches or bulky run logs are added to the PR or newly pushed history.**
- [x] ACTS conversion checks all 46,682 planes / 54 groups / 120 volumes and the complete native JSON round trip. 128 seeded straight navigation probes completed and crossed all seven systems; independent source comparison passes. Three seeded Geant4 geantinos saved three events / one run.
- [x] Full ROOT native PASS: **636,460 placements, 46,682 unique sensitive IDs, 64,080 cell round trips, 180,288 shape probes and zero overlaps/extrusions at 1e-5 mm**. Supplementary PASS: **617,018 exact physical solids, 1,316 material definitions, 200 protected sources and complete regenerated artifacts**; maximum elemental mass-fraction residual 1.12e-16. The aggregate integration summary is 26 KB.
- [ ] Current-PR interaction record, labels, final project/session/usage/site checks and GitHub CI completed.

Prepared for human review and merge after the final gates; this change does not merge the PR or grant detector engineering acceptance.

## Executive summary

Integrate the human-requested **703 mm short-strip module/services redesign** into the maintained combined DD4hep tracker, following the 2 mm readout selection in merged #109. The actual ODD TDR has been updated, compiled, visually checked and published to the explicitly authorized Overleaf main branch at `80a6c998cb9002d0d116bd8c4a414193e904bbd2`.

- Short-strip endcaps now contain **396 modules/disc, 4,752 in total**, with five redesigned rings. The sampled full-azimuth target is 703 mm; the finite active corner reaches 704.909 mm. The active radial gap to unchanged long strips falls **114.758 → 82.335 mm**.
- Default DD4hep includes the redesigned two-tile module stack, backing/core windows, direct thermal saddles, 0.17 mm local copper, two cooling loops per endcap petal and one partitioned **717–781.5 mm** shared service trunk. Power, optical and cooling counts are independent; fan/trunk payload and tray walls are counted once.
- The conservative changed-component estimate is **−114.6 kg with no cable-insulation credit** (−287.8 kg under the original insulation proxy). This is a scoped design estimate, not a complete tracker mass or directional material result.

The complete tracker has **46,682 sensitive planes / 54 signed groups**. Pixel and long-strip sensors are preserved. The historical 46,250-plane physical geometry and its evidence remain explicit controls.

![Redesigned module stack and thermal contacts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/codex/short-strip-services-2mm-baseline/docs/validation/DES-043/figures/module-redesign.png)

![Radial handoff and service capacity](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/codex/short-strip-services-2mm-baseline/docs/validation/DES-043/figures/handoff-capacity.png)

\[
R_\text{bond}\leq\frac{50\times10^{-6}}
 {1.2\,[2(0.0234)^2]}
=0.03804758\ {\rm K/W}.
\]

T_\text{screen,new}=T_\text{screen,old}
